Name: Cute Ghost - Pet Replacement Pink ver
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][b][center]~ Cute Ghost Pet ~[/center][/b]

[/size]
[size=4]Want to take care of a little cute ghost? 

[/size]Remember it replaces the default dog, the first one ;)

(It still does not have a sound, I'll update it as soon as I can for it to have one)


[center]As you can see in "Files", it has two options:
Non-transparent and transparent
Take a look in the pictures and decide which one you like the most, download it and love him![/center]
[u]
Remember in my profile you can find the white ghost version, the original one!
[b]
PLUS: Check out this inverted recolor of the cute ghost made by lusif1!!! It is so cute <3 https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19044[/b]
[/u]



[size=5][i][b][center]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/center][/b]
[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files". (Choose only ONE folder! Not both!)[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]


[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
